title: Use percentage controls for route height buckets
summary: Replace manual 1080p/1440p/4K pixel-boundary inputs in the WebView settings builder with visible 1080p and 4K percentage controls while deriving the 1440p buffer range, and add bitrate-size estimates for 30-minute TV and 2-hour movie durations.
reason: The operator should not need to type pixel endpoints such as 1200p for 1080p; the UI can keep the existing persisted tolerance keys and derive contiguous bucket boundaries.
behavior_before: The Settings route target table exposed four pixel boundary controls and converted those values into hidden percentage tolerance fields.
behavior_after: The Settings route target table exposes 1080p and 4K percentage controls, derives the 1440p lower and upper tolerances as the buffer, shows small grey constant-bitrate size estimates for 30-minute TV and 2-hour movie durations, and keeps backend Preview/Save validation authoritative.
